interpretation: The prefix follows the approved full-panel ordering under this resource budget.
The focused cases support a separate horizon review and are not pooled into full-panel scores.
Resource failures remain measured outcomes with checked incumbents and all denominator contributions.
Host names, CPU assignments and fresh runtime inventories require the actual future OAR allocation.
This artifact records a recommendation for inspection and does not authorize or execute the main campaign.

main_analysis.aggregation: Equal instance weights, with equal trial weights within each instance. All scheduled cells remain in the denominator.
main_analysis.attainment_rule: A checked incumbent attains a target when its raw gap is at most the target. Missing incumbents do not attain any target.
main_analysis.deliverable_scope: Bound-residual, availability and status-matrix figures are main-analysis deliverables, not pilot-completion or main-launch gates.
deliverables: Mean squeezed-gap and raw-gap target-attainment curves at all frozen targets.
Reported computational-closure attainment and restricted mean closure time, with checked witnesses and native guard qualifications.
Mean compatible primal-dual residual (U - L) / U, with explicit missing-pair convention and bound availability.
Aligned per-instance status matrix with trial proportions or labelled trial panels and separate failure/guard annotations.

resource_shape.availability: Must be rechecked before any reservation

selection_rule: minimum restricted mean reported closure time
